## Trial `kernel-network-hardening-ubuntu2__G8RyAbj`

**Verifier decision: Full Success.** The executor persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP-redirect and source-routed-packet acceptance on node1 by creating /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf, applying it live, and verifying the change survived a full reboot with a changed boot identity, matching the fixed global boot-identity snapshots. The mandatory node-restart evidence protocol was also satisfied with a clean pre/post transition and no residual issues.

| Reward | Coverage | Functionality | Hygiene | Confidence | Commands |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.970 | 0.950 | 11/1 |

### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **req-1 — Satisfied:** Persistently disable acceptance of ICMP redirects for IPv4 on node1
  - **Why:** Baseline showed net.ipv4.conf.all/default.accept_redirects=1 (cmd-d52e6dbc69b74632). Executor created /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf setting all/default.accept_redirects=0, applied live with sysctl --system, and verified runtime values=0 (cmd-9d7fccb516f043f2, cmd-561590c542b845cd, cmd-31b4b78d66d549e5). Per-interface (enp1s0/lo) values remained 1 but the kernel applies AND-logic between 'all' and per-interface settings for accept_redirects, so setting 'all'=0 disables acceptance network-wide regardless of legacy per-interface values. Post-reboot verification (cmd-f662c235abf94fc5) confirms values remain 0 and the config file persisted, demonstrating true persistence across a reboot.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-d52e6dbc69b74632`, `cmd-9d7fccb516f043f2`, `cmd-561590c542b845cd`, `cmd-31b4b78d66d549e5`, `cmd-f662c235abf94fc5`
- **req-2 — Satisfied:** Persistently disable acceptance of source-routed packets for IPv4 on node1
  - **Why:** Baseline showed net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route=1 (net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route was already 0) (cmd-d52e6dbc69b74632). Executor's new config file sets all/default.accept_source_route=0, applied and verified live (cmd-9d7fccb516f043f2, cmd-561590c542b845cd, cmd-31b4b78d66d549e5). Same AND-logic applies for accept_source_route, so the 'all'=0 setting is effective network-wide despite per-interface residual value=1. Post-reboot verification (cmd-f662c235abf94fc5) confirms values remain 0 and config persisted.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-d52e6dbc69b74632`, `cmd-9d7fccb516f043f2`, `cmd-561590c542b845cd`, `cmd-31b4b78d66d549e5`, `cmd-f662c235abf94fc5`
- **req-3 — Satisfied:** Configuration takes effect without conflicting with existing persistent sysctl settings
  - **Why:** Executor inspected existing /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf files and /etc/sysctl.conf before creating the new file, confirming any existing directives for these settings were commented out or unrelated (rp_filter only), so the new 60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf file applies cleanly without conflict.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-c13168c161b14efc`, `cmd-732ec3fe3d3e4481`
- **req-4 — Satisfied:** Mandatory provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol on node1
  - **Why:** Pre-restart healthy baseline boot_id=37344ae4... captured (cmd-b805256b29794c4f), matching the global before_prepare boot-identity snapshot. Restart acknowledged via backgrounded reboot command returning before disconnect (cmd-e3e322077ba440e8). Node observed unreachable mid-reboot (cmd-0d65495a79d343f5). Post-restart boot_id=d5be2f6d... differs from baseline (cmd-0625063076124e10), matching the global after_executor boot-identity snapshot. Recovered state confirmed: sysctl values and config file intact post-reboot (cmd-f662c235abf94fc5), and global after_executor snapshot shows no failed services and healthy package state.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-b805256b29794c4f`, `cmd-e3e322077ba440e8`, `cmd-0d65495a79d343f5`, `cmd-0625063076124e10`, `cmd-f662c235abf94fc5`, `global:before_prepare:node1:boot-identity`, `global:after_executor:node1:boot-identity`, `global:after_executor:node1:failed-services`, `global:after_executor:node1:package-health`
